audit.whatIsWrong: Ground Slam is never mentioned in either layer. The entry treats Malphite's armour purely as defence, so the stated reason the lane gets harder is only half the reason.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.' It is a flat 7 seconds at every rank. Every armour item he buys is also a damage item, and the attack-speed cut lands directly on the Drakehound's Step empowered auto your whole pattern is built around. That is what makes the two-item wall unwinnable, not armour alone.
audit.corrected: Named in spikes[2].text, late, whys[2], whys[6] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is described as conditional on 'his Unstoppable Force being on cooldown' with no number attached, in a matchup where both ultimates share the same cooldown.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100 and Public Execution is 130/115/100. At rank 1 they are identical, so 'wait for his R' means one of you spends first and the other owns the next two minutes. Naming the number turns a vague instruction into a decision.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, wants.you[0], wants.foe[2] and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the 130s on both sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: The phrase 'R passive armor pen' appears five separate times across the content layer and is the stated reason Ambessa's burst works at all. Public Execution has no armour penetration.
audit.why: Riot's full text for it: 'Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.' No penetration, no heal, no passive component. Against the one champion in the game whose whole identity is armour, inventing armour penetration is the most dangerous possible error — it tells the player their kit solves a problem it does not.
audit.corrected: Removed from spikes[1], spikes[2], wants.you[1], wants.you[2], mid, late, whys[4] and whys[5], and replaced with the real mechanics (1250-range blink, suppression, slam) plus an honest armour-penetration itemisation call in wants.you[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Granite Shield is never mentioned, so nothing tells the player why a full commit sometimes evaporates.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.' A tank's 10% max health in front of a burst pattern is a large fraction of the burst, and it comes back for free every time you stop hitting him. Chip it off before you spend Public Execution.

audit.whatIsWrong: Seismic Shard is described only as 'Q slow', and Thunderclap is called a 'W-empowered auto'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Seismic Shard 'deals damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds' — he does not just slow you, he takes the speed and wears it, which is why disengaging after a trade fails. Thunderclap is not one empowered auto: 'for the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him', an on-hit AoE window on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8. That window is exactly the dense non-minion damage Repudiation's brace is paid for.
audit.corrected: Named and corrected in spikes[0].text, spikes[3].text, early, whys[1] and wants.foe[1]; the brace play is in phases[1].why.

audit.why: Malphite's kit file flags Seismic Shard and Ground Slam as 'grounding' and Thunderclap as 'shield'. Riot's descriptions support none of the three — Seismic Shard steals move speed, Ground Slam cuts attack speed, Thunderclap creates aftershocks. I made no claim that he can deny Drakehound's Step or that W gives him resistances. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion independently.

edits.before: Malphite owns these levels and you have to accept it. His Q chips you on every approach and the W-empowered auto cleaves into your face while you still have just Cunning Sweep and an energy bar gating your follow-up. Do not try to prove anything level 1 — last-hit at max range, eat the Q poke, and avoid stepping into his auto-W rhythm. The one thing in your favor: he has no real kill pressure, so as long as you farm and bank energy you survive untouched to your 6 spike.
edits.after: Malphite owns these levels and you have to accept it. Seismic Shard chips you on a flat 8s and steals your move speed, and Thunderclap's aftershocks cleave into your face while you still have just Cunning Sweep and an energy bar gating your follow-up. Do not prove anything level 1 — last-hit at max range and stay out of his auto rhythm. Granite Shield absorbs 10% of his max health and recharges every few seconds he goes unhit, so chip it off before you commit anything. He has no kill pressure: farm to 6.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your worst window — your combo cooldowns are longest and his Q-slow plus armor make your dash-weave trades feel like noodles off a wall. Then 6 flips it: Public Execution blinks you behind him, suppresses him and crashes him down, and your R passive armor pen finally lets your physical damage bite his armor. That is your kill — but only if his Unstoppable Force is down. Bait the engage or wait it out; never all-in into a Malphite who still has R to flip the fight on top of you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your worst window — Lacerate is 13s and Repudiation 18s while his Ground Slam is a flat 7s, so your dash-weave trades land like noodles off a wall. Then 6 flips it: Public Execution blinks 1250 to the farthest champion in the line, suppresses him and slams him down, and a suppressed Malphite cannot answer. That is your kill — but only if Unstoppable Force is down. Both ults are 130s at rank 1; never all-in into a Malphite who still has his.

edits.before: This is where you lose the matchup and you need to know it. He stacks armor — Frozen Heart, Randuin's, raw W — and your damage is entirely physical, so a two-item Malphite is a brick wall who flips you with Unstoppable Force into Q-slow before you can reset. Your R passive armor pen helps but never catches the raw armor he piles on. Get your lead at 6 and your first item, then stop forcing the 1v1: he's the engage tank your team answers with AP, not someone you solo.
edits.after: This is where you lose the matchup and you need to know it. He stacks armour — Frozen Heart, Randuin's — and Ground Slam turns every point of it into magic damage while cutting your attack speed, so his defence and his offence are the same purchase. A two-item Malphite is a brick wall who flips you with Unstoppable Force into a Seismic Shard speed steal before you can reset. Get your lead at 6 and first item, then stop forcing the 1v1: he is the engage tank your team answers with AP.

edits.before: Even start that comes down to play: he only has Q poke level 1 while you have just Cunning Sweep and an energy gate — last-hit safe, bank energy, and the lane stays neutral.
edits.after: Even start: he has only Seismic Shard level 1 and you have Cunning Sweep and an energy gate — last-hit safe, chip Granite Shield when it is free, and the lane stays neutral.

edits.before: He out-trades you with Q-slow into a W-empowered auto while your single ability and long cooldowns can't punish back this early.
edits.after: He out-trades you with a Seismic Shard speed steal into Thunderclap's aftershocks while your long cooldowns can't punish back.

edits.before: His armor and Q poke beat your short dash-weave trades through 4-5 — your physical chip barely dents him and he just farms up untouched.
edits.after: Ground Slam is a flat 7s that scales off his armour and cuts your attack speed, so your dash-weave trades barely dent him and he farms up.

edits.before: This is your weakest window — longest combo cooldowns into his armor stack and Q slow; concede the lane and farm toward 6.
edits.after: Your weakest window — Lacerate 13s and Repudiation 18s against his flat 7s Ground Slam; concede and farm toward 6.

edits.before: Public Execution blinks you behind him, suppresses him and crashes him down, and your R passive armor pen lets the burst bite his armor — your one clean kill if his Unstoppable Force is down.
edits.after: Public Execution blinks 1250 to the farthest champion in the line, suppresses him on arrival and slams him down — your one clean kill, and only if Unstoppable Force is already spent.

edits.before: Eclipse's two-hit plus your R passive armor pen finally let Q1-into-Sundering-Slam chunk him, but it's a wash since he buys his second armor item right back.
edits.after: Eclipse's two-hit finally lets Q1-into-Sundering-Slam chunk him, but it's a wash: he buys his second armour item right back, and that is a Ground Slam damage item too.

edits.before: Two-item Malphite's stacked armor blanks your physical-only kit and Unstoppable Force into Q-slow flips you — you cannot win this 1v1.
edits.after: Stacked armour blanks your physical-only kit while feeding Ground Slam, and Unstoppable Force into a speed steal flips you — no 1v1 here.

edits.before: Dash-resets stack your passive shield mid-trade. Only take the trade when Malphite's Unstoppable Force is down.
edits.after: Repudiation is your shield, not the passive — brace Thunderclap's aftershocks and blocked damage pays for the slam.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — His engage. Dash it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: 130s at rank 1, same as yours — whoever spends first loses the next two minutes. - Ground Slam: flat 7s, scales off his armour. - Seismic Shard: flat 8s. - Thunderclap: 10s.

edits.before: His engage. Dash it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 130s at rank 1, exactly your R. Engage once he spends it.

notes: 'R passive armor pen' was the load-bearing claim of this whole entry and it does not exist — Riot's Public Execution text has no penetration, no heal and no passive. Against Malphite specifically that error is the difference between 'your kit solves armour' and 'buy penetration or you lose'. Ground Slam was also missing entirely, which matters because it makes his armour purchases offensive as well as defensive and cuts the attack speed her empowered-auto pattern depends on. Sides and ratings here already match the completed mirror at audits/top/malphite__ambessa.json (Skill, Malphite, Malphite, Skill, Skill, Malphite, Malphite; EVEN 6/10) so I changed neither. Malphite's derived 'grounding' flags on Q and E and 'shield' flag on W contradict Riot's own descriptions and I made no claim from them — the mirror auditor reached the same conclusion.
